prompt.en: Listen: 'bell', 'well'. Do they sound the same at the end?
prompt.hi: Suno: 'bell', 'well'. Kya dono ka end same sound karta hai? Yes ya no?

challenges.hint: Listen to the last part of each word.

prompt.en: Which word rhymes with 'hill': 'still' or 'hat'?
prompt.hi: 'Hill' ke saath kaunsa rhyme karta hai — 'still' ya 'hat'?

challenges.hint: Rhyming words end the same, they need not start the same.

prompt.en: Listen: 'bell' and 'ball'. They both start with /b/. Do they rhyme?
prompt.hi: 'Bell' aur 'ball' — dono /b/ se shuru hote hain. Par kya ye rhyme karte hain?

challenges.hint: One ends in -ell. What does the other end in?

prompt.en: Here is a NEW line, not in our rhyme: 'Ring, ring, I ride so far, faster than a little ___.' Which word fits and rhymes with 'far': 'car' or 'fan'?
prompt.hi: Ek nayi line suno, jo hamari rhyme mein nahi hai: 'Ring, ring, I ride so far, faster than a little ___.' Kaunsa word fit hoga aur 'far' se rhyme karega — 'car' ya 'fan'?

challenges.hint: Listen to the end of 'far': -ar.

prompt.en: Where do you sit on a bicycle: on the seat or on the pedal?
prompt.hi: Cycle pe tum kahan baithte ho — seat pe ya pedal pe?

challenges.hint: Your feet go on the pedals. Where does the rest of you go?

prompt.en: Two girls are jumping over a long rope. What game are they playing: skipping or cricket?
prompt.hi: Do ladkiyan lambi rassi ke upar kood rahi hain. Kaunsa game hai — skipping ya cricket?

challenges.hint: Cricket needs a bat. These girls have a rope.

prompt.en: A frog goes jump, jump, jump on its strong legs. Which word is it: hop or crawl?
prompt.hi: Mendhak apne mazboot pairon se jump-jump karta hai. Kaunsa word — hop ya crawl?

challenges.hint: Crawl is slow and low. A frog goes up and down.

prompt.en: A dog walks on four legs. A snake has no legs. Does a snake walk or crawl?
prompt.hi: Kutta chaar pairon se walk karta hai. Saanp ke pair nahi hote. Snake walks ya crawls?

challenges.hint: A snake moves on its tummy along the ground.

prompt.en: Which word rhymes with 'hop': 'stop' or 'swim'?
prompt.hi: 'Hop' ke saath kaunsa rhyme karta hai — 'stop' ya 'swim'?

challenges.hint: Rhyming words end the same: -op.

prompt.en: Tara came to school on Monday. Today is Tuesday. Did Tara come yesterday or tomorrow?
prompt.hi: Tara Monday ko school aayi. Aaj Tuesday hai. Toh Tara 'yesterday' aayi ya 'tomorrow'? Dhyaan do — Hindi ka 'kal' dono ke liye hota hai!

challenges.hint: One word is for the day that is gone, one for the day still to come.

prompt.en: Which one moves on water: a boat or a bus?
prompt.hi: Paani pe kaun chalta hai — boat ya bus?

challenges.hint: A bus needs a road.

prompt.en: Which word rhymes with 'train': 'rain' or 'tree'?
prompt.hi: 'Train' ke saath kaunsa word rhyme karta hai — 'rain' ya 'tree'?

challenges.hint: Rhyming words end the same: -ain.

prompt.en: A new line for a boat: 'Splash goes the boat, see it ___!' Which word fits and rhymes with 'boat': 'float' or 'ship'?
prompt.hi: Boat ki nayi line: 'Splash goes the boat, see it ___!' Kaunsa word 'boat' se rhyme karega — 'float' ya 'ship'?

challenges.hint: It must end like 'boat': -oat.

prompt.en: Bittu reads 'walk' and says 'wal-ak', with an /l/ sound. In 'walk', one letter is quiet. Which letter: w, l or k?
prompt.hi: Bittu 'walk' ko 'wal-ak' padhta hai, /l/ bol ke. 'Walk' mein ek letter chup rehta hai. Kaunsa — w, l ya k?

challenges.hint: Do you hear the /w/? the /k/? Which one is missing?

prompt.en: Listen and look as I read and point to each word: 'The dog sat by the tree.' Clap every time you hear 'the'. How many times was it?
prompt.hi: Main padhti hoon aur har word pe ungli rakhti hoon: 'The dog sat by the tree.' Jab bhi 'the' suno, taali bajao. Kitni baar aaya?

challenges.hint: Now listen just before 'tree'.

prompt.en: Where do we go when we are sick: a hospital or a park?
prompt.hi: Jab hum beemar hote hain toh kahan jaate hain — hospital ya park?

challenges.hint: Doctors work there.

prompt.en: Listen: 'high', 'sky'. Do they rhyme?
prompt.hi: Suno: 'high', 'sky'. Kya ye rhyme karte hain?

challenges.hint: Listen to the end sound of each.

prompt.en: Which word rhymes with 'blow': 'snow' or 'blue'?
prompt.hi: 'Blow' ke saath kaunsa rhyme karta hai — 'snow' ya 'blue'?

challenges.hint: Rhyming words end the same: -ow.

prompt.en: 'Grey' and 'away' look different when we write them. Do they rhyme when we say them?
prompt.hi: 'Grey' aur 'away' likhne mein alag dikhte hain. Bolne mein rhyme karte hain kya?

challenges.hint: gr-ey, aw-ay. Listen to the end.

prompt.en: Which word rhymes with 'crow': 'toe' or 'cat'?
prompt.hi: 'Crow' ke saath kaunsa rhyme karta hai — 'toe' ya 'cat'?

challenges.hint: Listen for the -oh sound at the end.

prompt.en: Was the monkey really helping the cats? Why do you think so?
prompt.hi: Kya bandar sach mein billiyon ki madad kar raha tha? Tumhe aisa kyun lagta hai?

challenges.hint: Did the cats get any roti?

prompt.en: Which word rhymes with 'drop': 'stop' or 'drip'?
prompt.hi: 'Drop' ke saath kaunsa word rhyme karta hai — 'stop' ya 'drip'?

challenges.hint: Rhyming words end the same: -op.

prompt.en: Which can fill a lake: one drop or many drops?
prompt.hi: Jheel kaun bhar sakta hai — ek boond ya bahut saari boondein?

challenges.hint: How big is a lake?

prompt.en: Bittu says 'hand' and 'hat' rhyme because both start with /h/. Is he right? Which word from our poem rhymes with 'hand'?
prompt.hi: Bittu kehta hai 'hand' aur 'hat' rhyme karte hain kyunki dono /h/ se shuru hote hain. Kya woh sahi hai? Hamari poem mein 'hand' ke saath kaunsa rhyme karta hai?

challenges.hint: Hand ends in -and. Does 'hat' end in -and?
